_about: Purnima fast (Upavasa / Vrat) days for New Delhi, the only day the app lists as Purnima. Rule: the day Purnima begins if it has begun by the end of that day's Madhyahna (three fifths of daylight), else the next day. Test reference only.
sources: 2025: Drik Panchang posts for New Delhi: Shravana Purnima Upavasa 9 Aug 2025 (Purnima 2:12 PM 8 Aug - 1:24 PM 9 Aug); Ashwina Purnima Upavasa 6 Oct 2025 (begins 12:23 PM 6 Oct).
2026: Drik Panchang 2026 Purnima Days, New Delhi (via search results), identical to Prokerala Purnima Vrat 2026.
2027: valkala.com/purnima, each date checked against Drik Panchang and AstroSage for New Delhi; Shravana and Kartika 2027 also list the following day as an alternate.
